beats.text: This returns the digital speculation to the ordinary wallet where the journey began.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the prologue’s wallet, then use the design grammar to compare its contents.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Follow a local experiment before moving into cryptocurrency and programmable financial systems.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later stress comparisons reveal consequences a catalogue of innovations would easily miss.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book suits readers interested in monetary institutions as well as technical novelty.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its depth lies in comparing purposes, governing powers, and failures across different traditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You need not endorse every proposal to make that comparison useful.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to recognize which promises your money carries, and who can rewrite them.
